requirements.requirement: TDL/CDL restrictions (valid carrier, BW, array/model limitations) are checked at standardized-record admission (`datasets/standardized.py::validate_standardized_channel_admission`, called by `StandardizedChannelRecord`). The declared sampled bandwidth is `num_subcarriers × subcarrier_spacing_hz`; nominal RF channel bandwidth is a distinct optional field. Native Sionna 2.2 adapter tests in `tests/test_integrations/test_g4_admission_native.py` verify multi-antenna TDL/CDL records, out-of-scope rejection, and fixed TS 38.101-4 profile availability: A30 FR1/FR2, B100/C300 FR1, C60 FR2, D30 FR1/FR2, and A10/D10 FR2 only with explicit nominal channel bandwidth >200 MHz. Fixed profile resources are identified as TS 38.101-4 V19.2.2. Dataset contract tests in `tests/test_datasets/test_standardized.py` accept carrier endpoints 0.5/100 GHz and 2 GHz sampled bandwidth, reject outside carrier/bandwidth limits and inconsistent sampled-bandwidth provenance, verify supported scalable-table versions, TDL correlation metadata and CDL panel counts against antenna axes, and preserve the single-TX/single-RX link restriction. Scalable-model limits and model restrictions are described by [Sionna 2.2 TDL documentation](https://nvlabs.github.io/sionna/v2.2.0/phy/api/channel/wireless/sionna.phy.channel.tr38901.TDL.html) and [CDL documentation](https://nvlabs.github.io/sionna/v2.2.0/phy/api/channel/wireless/sionna.phy.channel.tr38901.CDL.html); the fixed-profile map comes from its [versioned profile documentation](https://nvlabs.github.io/sionna/_modules/sionna/phy/channel/tr38901/tdl.html), while FR1/FR2 boundaries follow TS 38.101-1/-2 Table 5.1-1.
